text:
𝟭𝟵 𝗪𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧𝗦 𝗜𝗡 𝗢𝗡𝗘 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 🤯

Jim Laker, Old Trafford 1956: 9/37 and 10/53 against Australia.
Match figures of 19/90 are still the best in Test history. 🏏

#Cricket #TestCricket

👉 Jim Laker – Old Trafford, 1956 Ashes
👉 Pehli pari 9/37, doosri pari 10/53
